title: Crypto Guardian
tagline: Your fail-safe for digital asset security. Configure a smart contract with Chainlink automation to transfer assets if you lose access or set it for inheritance.
description: Explore Crypto Guardian—an innovative cross-chain solution for decentralized asset security. Easily craft custom smart contracts on our intuitive frontend, seamlessly connecting wallets and defining parameters. Deploy across multiple chains with flawless integration into Chainlink automation. Top up with LINK tokens for perpetual activation. Safeguard assets and plan for inheritance with precision. Your crypto legacy, fortified and decentralized, starts here.
how_its_made: Crypto Guardian is built on a Next.js frontend, offering an intuitive user experience. Leveraging Solidity for smart contract logic, we prioritize security by allowing users to generate personalized contracts on our frontend. This tailored approach ensures heightened security and flexibility, as each user configures a smartcontract that precisely meets their needs. In essence, it's a technical fusion of Next.js, Solidity, and user-specific schema generation for a robust and customizable decentralized asset security solution.
